brief.symptoms: The consumer group repeatedly fails to find its coordinator and logs an authorization error, causing the Consume() method to hang indefinitely.
brief.evidence:
[Sarama] 2023/01/25 15:27:40 client/coordinator retrying after 250ms... (3 attempts remaining)
[Sarama] 2023/01/25 15:27:40 client was not authorized to access group kafka-demo while attempting to find coordinator
... (loop continues)
hints: The consumer keeps trying to locate its coordinator even after receiving an authorization error.
Check the logic that handles coordinator lookup failures in the consumer group.
The fix involves decrementing the retry counter and returning early when retries are exhausted.
brief.lesson: When a consumer group cannot access its coordinator, the retry logic must stop after a finite number of attempts to avoid an infinite loop.
